content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the SVNIT Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of SVNIT to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SVNIT Assistant Professor Grade-II Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the SVNIT Assistant Professor Grade-II recruitment is 14 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the SVNIT Assistant Professor Grade-II recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Assistant Professor Grade-II post at SVNIT. These vacancies are distributed across different departments as mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for SVNIT Assistant Professor Grade-II posts?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the SVNIT Assistant Professor Grade-II recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any charges.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for Assistant Professor Grade-II at SVNIT?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD in a relevant discipline as per Annexure II. Specific departmental qualifications are also detailed as per Schedule E of NIT Statutes.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Assistant Professor Grade-II at SVNIT?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Assistant Professor Grade-II post at SVNIT will receive a salary as per Pay Level 10. This is a full-time government job opportunity.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for SVNIT Assistant Professor Grade-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for Assistant Professor Grade-II at SVNIT involves two main stages: scrutiny of applications followed by an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their eligibility.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the SVNIT Assistant Professor Grade-II posts?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official SVNIT website. The application process involves filling out the form, uploading documents, and submitting it before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for SVNIT Assistant Professor Grade-II?
faq.answer: The job location for the Assistant Professor Grade-II post is Surat, Gujarat, as Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology is located in Surat.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this SVNIT recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for the SVNIT Assistant Professor Grade-II recruitment is Estt. /2023/Faculty/3336/IX/994. This number helps in identifying the specific notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age limit specified for these posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention a specific age limit summary for these posts. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed official notification for any age-related criteria or relaxations.
